subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become a supported public Plugin SDK primitive for channel lifecycle boundaries, including the locked-harness release contract, or should this work be redesigned behind a narrower owner-controlled seam?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and the earlier ownership-guard defect was repaired, but API permanence and the cross-plugin harness handoff are product and compatibility decisions that source review cannot safely make alone.

options.title: Adopt the scoped lifecycle API
options.body: Accept the documented Plugin SDK reset primitive as the canonical lifecycle-boundary API and merge after the current head's required checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the seam first
options.body: Require a redesign that keeps the Teams behavior behind a more limited owner-controlled API before exposing a permanent Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the Teams lifecycle behavior until maintainers define the long-term session-reset and harness-ownership contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped lifecycle API
recommendation.body: Accept the documented Plugin SDK reset primitive as the canonical lifecycle-boundary API and merge after the current head's required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties steipete to the personal-chat scoping refinement and direct review engagement on this PR's ownership-sensitive path.
